claim.claim-text: 4. The LED lamp according to claim 3, wherein the connection part comprises a connection housing and a plug, wherein the plug is connected to the connection housing.

6. The LED lamp according to claim 1, wherein the connector comprises a connection control part; the connection control part comprises a connection circuit board and a second connection terminal; the connection circuit board is connected to the second connection terminal.
7. The LED lamp according to claim 6, wherein the second connection terminal is one or more of an electrode pin, a DC interface, and a USB interface.
